ideas.name: any warning against the opening gap
ideas.why: a gap from settlement leaves overnight traders on one side; turns that call back toward settlement have gap-fill flow behind them

ideas.name: any warning with both day extremes an hour old
ideas.why: if neither the day's high nor low has moved in 60 minutes the market has found its range, and turns inside a range pay

ideas.name: any warning on a bar closing its way
ideas.why: a warning whose own bar closed in the called half of its range (close location over 0.5 its way) already shows sellers (buyers) winning the minute

ideas.name: any warning after 3+ fresh extremes in 30 min
ideas.why: three or more new session highs (lows) in half an hour, with the warning calling against them, is a run that has drawn in late buyers (sellers), who give up into the turn

ideas.name: any warning inside the prior day's range
ideas.why: inside yesterday's range both sides have traded and accepted prices; turns there rotate, outside it price is discovering and runs
